items.title: Italian Enterprises Leading in AI—Built on MongoDB Atlas
items.summary: We often talk about AI as if it were magic. A black box that simply knows things. But the reality is that AI models are engines: high-performance, hungry, and only as good as the fuel you feed them and the block that holds them together.

items.title: How to Encrypt LangGraph Checkpoints With MongoDB CSFLE
items.summary: Would you trust an AI agent if a database administrator could read every message in its session? For a customer-facing chatbot, that reality already feels unsettling. Even if you trust your internal operators, plaintext checkpoints remain equally readable to anyone who gains database access during a breach.
